WHAT WAS AUTHORED: a configuration-only ROS 1 RosDriver for the pinned KUKA LWR loopback simulation. Primary control is one x-cap.epfl-lasa.joint_velocity.v1 invoke action that publishes one iai_control_msgs/MultiJointVelocityImpedanceCommand on /r_arm_vel/command. The README names /r_arm_vel/command and /joint_states (sensor_msgs/JointState) at README.md:56; the controller subscribes the relative command topic at iai_stuff/iai_control_pkgs/iai_robot_mechanism_controllers/src/multi_joint_velocity_impedance_controller.cpp:124, its callback takes the command type at :211-220, and the generated-type include is cited as type_ref at iai_stuff/iai_control_pkgs/iai_robot_mechanism_controllers/include/iai_robot_mechanism_controllers/multi_joint_velocity_impedance_controller.h:52. The controller configuration names r_arm_vel and the seven right_arm_0_joint through right_arm_6_joint joints at kuka_lwr_bringup/config/lwr_sim_vel_controllers.yaml:1-10. Resource reads are joint_positions and joint_velocities from /joint_states; the explicit x-cap.epfl-lasa.joint_states.v1 read returns the full ROS 1 JointState. The README's /KUKA/joint_imp_cmd path uses the external kuka_fri_bridge/JointStateImpedance type, which is not in the pinned clone, so the package binds the parser's /r_arm_vel/command output directly instead.

MODEL REVIEW (grok-4.7, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Repaired the HELPER_MISSING block with one simulated ROS 1 sensed_stop (SAFE-049, CORE-088). The request publishes seven zero velocities on /r_arm_vel/command with timeout_ms 500 and proves nothing by itself. The stop commits only when /r_arm_vel/state shows every desired.velocities element inside an operator_required abs_max and the norm of actual.velocities.0 through actual.velocities.6 inside an operator_required norm_max, on two consecutive fresh producer-stamped samples (min_span_ms 40, max_gap_ms 500, confirm_within_ms 800). estop_latency_ms is 1300, the request timeout plus confirm_within_ms. The source declares no history: ROS 1 replay discards the first sample. Fill refs cite multi_joint_velocity_impedance_controller.cpp:199 (desired.velocities[j] = command[j]) and :201 (actual.velocities[j] = velocity_). The clone states no numeric rest band, so both thresholds are operator_required. fixtures/estop-confirmation.json holds fake placeholders only (desired_v0 through desired_v6 at 0.0, actual_norm at 0.02), not device facts. A competing publisher leaves desired and actual off zero, so the stop stays unconfirmed with the latch held. Reset reconfirms read-only and is refused RESET_REFUSED when the sensed state no longer holds. There is no unpause and no re-enable (SAFE-042). The fake sets measured velocity equal to the commanded velocity at once and does not integrate the loopback. Realtime launches can put a real arm's joint states on /joint_states; the sensed source is /r_arm_vel/state, and the same controller class behind /r_arm_vel/command would act on the publication. The SDK cannot prove the graph is simulated.
